name: AnyForge
tagline: Drive governed agentic engineering in AnyForge from your coding agent
description: Dispatch and steer AnyForge engineering crews, drive Code Studio sessions, review and approve human-in-the-loop gates, and manage programs, initiatives and work items without leaving your editor. Requires an AnyForge account. Sign in with OAuth; the connection acts as you and its scopes are capped by your AnyForge role.

install.notes: Requires an AnyForge account. Authorize the connection with OAuth using your own account; no API key is needed. Tools that change data or approve gates are annotated for confirmation. Setup and support: https://anyforge.ai/docs?page=mcp-server
